note: Company-stated mine life / reserve life. Updated by hand when companies release new reserves or life-extension news.

boddington.t: Newmont: mine life to 2040 (extension to 2046 proposed)

tropicana.t: Reserves cover only ~4 years at current output, but the JV has replaced mined ounces every year

kcgm-super-pit-fimiston.t: Super Pit open pit to 2034 (Fimiston South); reserves incl. underground support 20+ years

tanami-callie.t: Newmont: Tanami Expansion 2 extends life to ~2040

st-ives.t: Gold Fields: mine life stretching to 2045

telfer.t: Current open-pit plan to about FY2028; Greatland is drilling for multi-year extensions (leases run to 2045)

greenbushes.t: IGO: 23+ years of life defined by Ore Reserves (CY23)

pilgangoora.t: PLS (Oct 2026): ~20 years at P2000 rates from open pits, 25+ years incl. underground

ngungaju.t: Part of Pilgangoora: ~20 years open pit, 25+ incl. underground (PLS, Oct 2026)

gruyere.t: Open-pit life of mine to 2032; underground studies could extend it

ernest-henry.t: Evolution: mine life to at least 2040

mt-arthur.t: BHP plans to close Mt Arthur in 2030

loy-yang.t: AGL: Loy Yang A power station and mine to close by 2035
